title: The City That Sang Itself Free: A Tallinn Walking Tour
creator: Lola Tinney
description: A walk from Viru Gate through the old town and up to Toompea, ending at Freedom Square, with the story of how Estonians sang their way out of the Soviet Union.

title: Tallinn Old Town Audio Tour: From Medieval Tales to Tech Hub
creator: Roddy McDougall
description: A walk from the Fat Margaret tower through the old town’s legends to a viewpoint near Freedom Square, where a plaque marks the start of the 1989 Baltic Way, with stops on how Estonia went digital.

title: Towers, Legends, and Communism: A Tallinn Self-Guided Audio Tour
creator: Anonymous Explorer
description: A long walk from Fat Margaret up St. Olaf’s tower, past the Alexander Nevsky Cathedral on Toompea, and through the city’s KGB stories, ending at the Kohtuotsa viewpoint.
